answer: Attackers must fund every identity, making mass registration costly, while honest participants find a haven in slashed deposits that deter copycat swarms. Sybil resistance comes from staking at the kernel layer: each agent must lock a bond before voting, and reputation slot proofs are anchored to a unique vertex in the trust graph, so fake accounts cannot cheaply multiply. In practice, Agent0075 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
